blocks.html: Horizontal formwork deck panels and beam formwork shall be positively connected to all formwork support systems. Connections located within 16 feet (4877 mm) from the building perimeter shall be installed continuously throughout the day as the formwork is installed and shall be in place prior to the end of the shift.
